name: Will regular maintenance extend the life of my tankless water heater?

mainEntity.name: Will regular maintenance extend the life of my tankless water heater?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, regular maintenance significantly extends the lifespan of your tankless water heater. By preventing mineral buildup and addressing minor issues early, you reduce wear and tear on critical components. For instance, in areas with hard water like Las Vegas, annual descaling is key to protecting the heat exchanger, which is often the most expensive part to replace, ultimately maximizing your investment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Regular maintenance, especially annual descaling in hard water areas, prevents wear and tear, significantly extending your tankless water heater's lifespan.
